public_body: Pioneer Valley Performing Arts Charter School Board Of Trustees
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: negotiating the contract in executive session under Purpose 2 was allowed, and approval occurred in open session. Public-comment limits were declined for review. The AG cautioned about notice and executive-session procedure without ordering any remedy.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the board improperly deliberated in executive session about renewing the Head of School's contract.
allegations.key_passage: Moreover, as required by the Open Meeting Law, formal approval of the contract occurred in open session on June 24.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the board restricted public input into the renewal of the Head of School's contract.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law does not require that a public body allow public participation but rather gives the chair of the public body discretion to decide whether to permit public comment during a meeting and to set limitations on public comment if it is allowed.

allegations.summary: AG's own review: a March 4 executive session notice did not identify the nonunion personnel to be negotiated with. Not part of the complaint.
AG's own review: calendar entries and notices suggested the board would meet in executive session without first meeting in open session. Not part of the complaint.
allegations.key_passage: Additionally, and perhaps of greater concern, at least two of the Board’s calendar entries and meeting notices gave the impression that the Board was to meet in executive session without first meeting in open session.
